PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.Title: Level Perspective
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.Distance: Measure distances on the perspective grid
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.ConfigHint: Settings are stored in the current Level flags. In the calibrator, both anchors are lines: dragging moves the line, and the mouse wheel over it rotates the line.
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.SelectLevelFirst: Select this level on the scene first, then open calibration.
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.OpenSceneAndSelectLev: Open a scene and select the level you want to configure.
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.SavedToLevel: Perspective Levels: settings saved to level "{level}".
PERSPECTIVE_LEVELS.CalibratorHint: Drag the two line anchors on the scene. The mouse wheel over a line rotates it; Shift+wheel makes fine adjustments. These lines define the ground plane.
